meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文榜单，提炼市场热点与热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者或编辑,想了解平台榜单背后的热门题材趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Scan web novel rankings to identify hot genres and trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author or editor wanting to understand market trends from ranking data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按用户指定的平台和方向采集起点、番茄、晋江等榜单数据，整理校验后输出扫榜报告，并产出 2-3 个带可行性、失败风险和验证动作的选题建议（写入选题决策.md）。
howto.when: 当用户用“/story-long-scan”“/长篇扫榜”等命令，或提出“长篇什么火”之类的扫榜请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点新人签约新书榜，看看最近什么题材火。
say.note: 会启动起点榜单脚本采集数据，并生成扫榜报告。

say.text: 番茄男频阅读榜现在什么火？给我出一份扫榜报告。
say.note: 会采集番茄榜单数据，分析题材热度与风向。

say.text: 扫完榜单后，帮我出几个能写的长篇选题方向。
say.note: 会进入选题决策，产出选题决策.md 文件。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a web-novel market analyst: it pulls ranking data from Qidian/Fanqie/Jinjiang, cleans and validates it, then writes a scan report and a 选题决策.md with 2-3 topic recommendations including feasibility and risks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user uses commands like “/story-long-scan”, “/长篇扫榜”, or phrases like “长篇什么火” to request a ranking scan.

say_en.text: Scan Qidian's new-signing author ranking and tell me what themes are hot.
say_en.note: Runs the Qidian scraper and generates a scan report.

say_en.text: What's hot on Fanqie's male-channel reading list? Give me a scan report.
say_en.note: Collects Fanqie list data and analyzes theme trends.

say_en.text: After scanning, give me a few topic directions for a long novel.
say_en.note: Produces a topic-decision file with recommendations.
